_about: S3371 dependency admission: the licence set this app already ships. Seeded from the distinct spdx values of app_v2/src/main/res/raw/oss_notices_*.json across all seven flavors, so the first PR run judges new dependencies rather than the project's own set. Regenerate the seed by re-reading those files; add an entry only with a reason.
_consumers: .github/workflows/dependency-scan.yml - allow-licenses is built from the spdx entries, allow-dependencies-licenses from the packages of the non-spdx ones

licenses.reason: The licence of almost every AndroidX, Google and Kotlin artifact the app builds on; permissive, no distribution obligation beyond the notice the app already ships.
Permissive, notice-only; already carried in every flavor's OSS notices.
Permissive, notice-only; shipped in every flavor.
Permissive, notice-only, plus a no-endorsement clause the app does not breach; shipped in every flavor.
The classpath exception is what makes it admissible: linking does not propagate the copyleft to the app.

Admissible while the library stays dynamically linked and replaceable, which is how these four flavors consume it. A NEW LGPL dependency that would be statically linked is a decision, not an allowlist hit.
noLegal only, and deliberately: that flavor is not distributed through a store. A GPL-3.0 dependency reaching any other flavor is a licence change for the whole app and must not pass silently.
Glide's composite expression. Every member is already allowed above; it is listed as a package exemption because the composite string is not a single SPDX identifier the PR gate can match.
Google's own SDK terms, not an SPDX identifier. Accepted per package rather than per licence, so a new Google artifact under the same terms is still reviewed.
Google's ML Kit terms, not SPDX. Named per package: the two the translation feature already ships.

licenses.id: Play Core Software Development Kit Terms of Service
licenses.reason: Google Play Core terms, not SPDX. Named per package: feature delivery and the in-app review prompt. foss ships neither.
